interventions.speaker: CHAIR
interventions.who: the senior urologist who signs the decision
interventions.body: The prognosis is influenced by several factors, including a preoperative PSA of 4.4 and an ISUP grade group 5 Gleason 4+5 on the prostatectomy specimen. Positive surgical margins are concerning findings that elevate risk. Conversely, the absence of seminal vesicle invasion and lymphovascular invasion are favorable elements. The biopsy history shows progression from lower-grade disease (ISUP group 2) to higher-grade disease (ISUP group 4/5), which is a noted discrepancy between initial sampling and final pathology. Nodal status was not reported as positive, but the documentation does not specify if nodes were removed or sampled, widening uncertainty in this area. Future prognosis assessment would be significantly revised by obtaining postoperative PSA levels and tracking their subsequent trajectory over time. The fixed estimated horizon is 56.82 months. This represents expected follow-up without an event, not a known recurrence date. The sensitivity range is 42.61–71.02 months; its coverage has not been validated.
